gigapan.description:
This is another micro-gigapan attampt, though it didn't turn out very well. It was taken near 200x magnification and the focus was adjusted by hand. The petals on the flower started curling up as I was taking the image causing some distortion I suspect in the composite image.

This Gigapan is part of the NanoGigaPan project. Which is working to take large pictures of very small things. 

Read more on the project blog at http://nanogigapan.blogspot.com 

and see more of our work on the gigapan site at http://gigapan.org/profiles/mollyg
